remarks: This bright second-floor unit in East Norwalk features one bedroom, an eat-in kitchen, a spacious living room, and a full bathroom. Additionally, there is attic storage space on the third floor. BRAND NEW CARPET will be installed before move-in to give the space a fresh, updated feel.  LOCATION, LOCATION, LOCATION! Conveniently situated just minutes from the East Norwalk train station, I-95, SONO, Veterans Park, and Calf Pasture Beach - you can even walk to the water!  The unit includes an in-unit washer and dryer, plus on-site parking.  Tenants are responsible for paying for gas, electricity, cable, and internet. Water is covered by the landlord.  Apply through RentSpree below! No Pets and No Smoking!!
